contract: Each case resets to crm_seed.json. Evaluate gates only; never dial. allowed means eligible for queue admission, not a call placed or a legal-compliance determination. No state changes in these fixtures. reasons lists every failing gate, sorted alphabetically. Times use the contact/business timezone Asia/Kolkata. A prior attempt within strictly less than 24 hours blocks; attempts >= 2 blocks. Callback end must not exceed 18:00 for requested 30-minute slots. Event IDs must be deduplicated before any future real enqueue.

cases.stop_condition: End after reporting eligible queue-admission label; never enqueue/dial.

evaluation_criteria.check: expected exact decision/reasons and whole seed unchanged; COMMUNICATE not applicable
